title: 我的周末

explanations.1: Use 几 to ask or indicate an unspecified small number, here referring to a few trees.
explanations.2: Use 西 to indicate the western direction, opposite of east.
explanations.3: Use 从 to indicate the starting point or source, here from the schoolbag.
explanations.4: Use 两 instead of 二 when counting items before a measure word like 瓶.
explanations.5: Use 吃 for eating food, here eating apples and bananas.
explanations.6: Use 这 to refer to something close, here this weekend.
explanations.7: Use 多 to describe a large quantity, here a lot of homework.
explanations.8: Use 页 as a measure word for pages of a book or writing.
explanations.9: Use 本 as a measure word for bound volumes like books.
explanations.10: Use 地 to turn an adjective into an adverb, describing how an action is done.
explanations.11: Use 哪儿 to ask about a location, here where you went to play.
explanations.12: Use 还 to add another item or action, here also did homework.
explanations.13: Use 会 to indicate ability learned or acquired, here being able to help.
explanations.14: Use 上 to indicate position on a surface, here on the table.

translation: Today is Saturday. I went to the park together with my friend. We were very happy in the park. There is a lake inside the park; beside the lake there are many flowers. On the east side of the lake there are several trees, and on the west side there is a small pavilion. I first walked around in the park for a while, then together with my friend I sat down on the grass. My friend took two bottles of water and some fruit out of his/her schoolbag. We drank water and ate apples and bananas while chatting. I felt that this really is a very happy weekend. In the afternoon, I went home to do homework. There was a lot of homework, but it wasn't difficult. I first wrote one page of Chinese characters, then read a storybook. Mom saw me studying very seriously at home; she was very happy. In the evening, I ate dinner together with my family. We ate rice, fish, and green vegetables. Dad asked me: 'Where did you go to play today?' I said: 'I went to the park, and I also did homework at home.' Dad said: 'You are such a good child!' I was very happy, because I can help Mom with housework. I put away the bowls and chopsticks on the table. Then I took a bath, and then I went to bed to sleep. This really was a happy weekend!
